onchange="changeWave()"><option value="square">Square</option><option value="sine">Sine</option><option value="triangle">Triangle</option><option value="sawtooth">Sawtooth</option></select></div><div><input id="pitch" type="range" min="100" max="1000" value="440" oninput="changePitch()"><label for="pitch">Pitch</label></div><div><input id="volume" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5" oninput="gainNode.gain.value = this.value"><label 20px;margin:5px;cursor:pointer}</style><script>const audioContext=new AudioContext;let oscillator;function startSound(){if(oscillator)return;audioContext.resume(),oscillator=audioContext.createOscillator();const t=document.querySelector("%23wave-select").value;oscillator.type=t,oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(document.querySelector("%23pitch").value,audioContext.currentTime),oscillator.connect(gainNode),oscillator.start()}function stopSound(){oscillator.stop(),oscillator.disconnect(),oscillator=null}function changePitch(){const t=document.querySelector("%23pitch").value;document.querySelector("%23current-pitch").innerHTML=t,oscillator&&oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(t,audioContext.currentTime)}function changeWave(){const t=document.querySelector("%23wave-select").value;oscillator&&(oscillator.type=t)}document.addEventListener("keydown",function(t){"Space"===t.code&&(t.preventDefault(),oscillator?stopSound():startSound())});const analyser=audioContext.createAnalyser();analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);const gainNode=audioContext.createGain();function randomPitch(){const t=Math.round(900*Math.random()+100);document.querySelector("%23pitch").value=t,changePitch()}gainNode.gain.value=.5,gainNode.connect(analyser);const canvas=document.querySelector("%23waveform"),canvasCtx=canvas.getContext("2d"),bufferLength=analyser.frequencyBinCount,dataArray=new Uint8Array(bufferLength);function drawWave(){requestAnimationFrame(drawWave),analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray),canvasCtx.fillStyle="%23363199",canvasCtx.fillRect(0,0,1e3,1e3),canvasCtx.strokeStyle="%23E8E085",canvasCtx.lineWidth=2,canvasCtx.beginPath();for(let t=0;t<bufferLength;t++){const e=t/bufferLength*canvas.width,a=dataArray[t]/128*(canvas.height/2);0===t?canvasCtx.moveTo(e,a):canvasCtx.lineTo(e,a)}canvasCtx.stroke()}drawWave();</script></body>
